name: Damned Vescavor Swarm
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean

defensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Mind
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.

offensiveAbilities.name: Devour All
offensiveAbilities.description: The swarm eat away the very earth beneath their feet. The swarms Strides. All squares they occupy during their movement becomes difficult terrain. Any creatures they move through must succeed a DC 23 Reflex Saving Throw save or fall Prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Maddening Gibbers
offensiveAbilities.description:
Each stupefied creature in the swarm's space must attempt a DC 23 Will Saving Throw saving throw as the swarm yammers the endless chorus of the Outer Rifts.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Maddening Gibbers for 1 minute.

Success The target is unaffected and is immune to Maddening Gibbers for 1 round.

Failure The target becomes Confused for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target becomes confused for 1 round and can't target demons while confused in this way.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ravenous Bites
offensiveAbilities.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes (3d6+2) Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save). A creature that fails its save is also Stupefied 1 for 1 round.
